description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test methods to verify the behavior and validation rules of the API endpoints for managing employee leave entitlements, including tests for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and listing entitlements, with focus on validation and permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI methods, validation rules, and permissions within the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that calling delete() on EmployeeLeaveEntitlementAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for delete endpoint, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that create() method triggers a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for create endpoint.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests that update() method triggers a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for update endpoint.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee leave entitlement, mocking dependencies and verifying correct normalization of data.

methods.name: testGetOneWithEmptyEntitlements
methods.description: Tests retrieving a leave entitlement when no matching records exist.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the getOne method, including permissions, leave type existence, and date validations.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all leave entitlements matching filters, verifying data normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for retrieving all entitlements with filters, including leave type validation and date consistency.
